title: Analysis code for: Vegetation dynamics along drydowns across global climate zones
description:
R code used to detect drydown events from a global daily water balance, accumulate cumulative water deficit (CWD), extract the high and low EVI percentile states along drydowns, classify energy-limited and water-limited regimes, compute the EVI-CWD sensitivity S, and produce the figures and tables of the associated manuscript.

Input datasets are not redistributed here; they are obtained from their original public sources, listed in the README.
